verifications.claim: Crimson Desert launches worldwide on March 19, 2026, for PC (Steam), PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S.

PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X and S'; R3: 'launching... on March 19, 2026, for PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X/S'; R5: 'released for macOS, PlayStation 5, Windows, and Xbox Series X/S on March 19, 2026'

verifications.label: CLEAR
